zh.title: 男装 Editorial｜以人物呈现服饰性格
zh.summary: 以条纹服饰为视觉主线，将人物形象准备纳入服饰制作，让穿着者的呈现赋予产品更具体的时尚表达。
zh.preview: 男装内容需要同时让人看见衣服与穿着者。围绕服饰开展妆造及制作，使人物形象成为理解造型的入口。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与服饰内容制作与妆造形象设计，以男装主题组织人物准备与影像产出。
zh.context: 本案以人物方式呈现男装，条纹服饰构成明确的视觉线索。制作任务需要处理服装与人物的关系，让观众既能辨识服饰，也能理解整体形象。

narrativeSections.heading: 服饰的性格由人物带出
narrativeSections.text: 条纹提供服饰自身的图形特征，人物则让衣服拥有穿着状态。两者共同组成画面，使服饰内容能够传达整体风格，而不仅是单件产品的信息。

narrativeSections.heading: 形象准备围绕服装展开
narrativeSections.text: 妆造形象设计与服饰制作属于同一工作范围。人物准备服务于穿着呈现，制作则将这一关系保留在最终影像中，让服饰主题贯穿准备与产出。

narrativeSections.heading: 为时尚表达提供具体参考
narrativeSections.text: 人物服饰影像可用于主题编辑、造型展示与创意讨论。这个小型项目的价值，是提供一份可被观看和讨论的风格材料，为后续服饰内容提供参照。

deliverables: 围绕男装呈现的人物妆造设计
以条纹服饰为主题的人物视觉内容
outcomes: 交付以人物呈现服饰风格的男装内容。
成片可作为造型展示与服饰视觉讨论的素材。

en.title: Menswear Editorial | Giving Clothing Character
en.summary: A striped garment anchors the image, with talent preparation and production bringing the clothing into a distinct personal presentation.
en.preview: Menswear imagery needs to show both the garment and the person wearing it. Makeup design and production addressed that relationship within a focused clothing assignment.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to apparel content production and makeup design, organising talent preparation around the menswear subject.
en.context: This talent-led menswear project used a striped garment as a clear visual thread. The production task concerned how clothing and personal appearance work together, making the garment legible within the overall look.

narrativeSections.heading: The wearer gives the garment context
narrativeSections.text: Stripes supply the clothing’s graphic character; the person gives it a worn presence. Together they communicate a look, adding a stylistic reading to the information carried by the garment itself.

narrativeSections.heading: Preparation follows the clothing
narrativeSections.text: Makeup design and apparel production sat within the same scope. Talent preparation served the way the clothing was presented, with the finished image holding that relationship in frame.

narrativeSections.heading: A useful point of reference
narrativeSections.text: Talent-led apparel imagery can support thematic editing, styling presentations and creative discussions. This focused project supplies a visible reference for those conversations, grounding an idea about style in a finished image.

deliverables: Makeup design for the menswear presentation
Talent-led imagery centred on a striped garment
outcomes: The delivered menswear content presents clothing through personal style.
The image offers material for styling presentations and apparel-focused creative discussions.
